description: Playwright multi-account harness: per-role saved sessions, recorded runs, long-lived CDP browser for ad-hoc UI checks; PR screenshots (spec-driven shots + upload to an orphan pr-assets branch)
setup: cd _tools/e2e && npm install && npx playwright install chromium
cp .env.example .env, then set E2E_BASE_URL, E2E_ROLES, <ROLE>_EMAIL/_PASSWORD (ask the user for credentials, never invent them)
Adapt tests/login.cjs selectors to the app's real login page
Add project gotchas at the bottom of .claude/skills/e2e-browser-verify/SKILL.md
